attestation._doc: The engines export carries no provenance block: no timestamp, no host, no architecture, no repetition count, nothing. So everything below is an attestation by the person who ran it, not something the runner observed, and history.json stamps the run provenanceSource: "attested" on the strength of it. The page says so out loud wherever an engines number appears. When libviprs-bench#75 makes the engines family emit a document of its own, this file goes away and the provenance becomes observed like the storage family's.
attestation.statement: This sweep ran in the same capture session as the storage document 20260914T145707Z-809ee8014d002518ce55edaceba698ca7a8b8a79-0bc00939, in the same container on the same host, from the same two checkouts, minutes after it. The host fields below are copied from that run's observed provenance on that basis, and the copy is the attestation. The export records one measurement per cell with no repetitions and no warm-up, so no cell here has dispersion and none of them is gateable.
